summary: Recover a suppressed listing: identify all suppression codes from the workbench export, draft compliant per-bullet copy grounded in the supplier evidence, swap the promo image for the clean one, attach a structured evidence_file + resolution_action per code, and write a topic-covered recovery note.

checks.description: Environment/format ready: corrected_listing_fields.json parses as an object, all required keys present, image_recommendation is a structured object, and recovery_note.md exists and is non-empty.
Title contains the canonical product specs (750, stainless, bottle) and none of the promo / competitor / unsupported banned phrases.

All five bullets are narrowed to evidence-supported, policy-compliant copy: bullet_1 material grounding (LFGB / 304 stainless), bullet_2 lab-tested cold-only (24h hot removed), bullet_3 leak-resistant / test-condition wording (no leak-proof), bullet_4 top-rack LoopCap / lid scope (no body-included claim), bullet_5 BPA-not-detected LoopCap evidence (no non-toxic / safe-for-kids). Per-bullet failures listed in reason.
Description is grounded in >=3 concrete product specs and contains no eco-friendly / zero-waste / carbon-neutral / best-seller claims.
Backend search_terms include >=4 distinct allowed-enum tokens, every token is in the allowed enum (no off-list / brand / promo terms), and none of the banned phrases appear.
Negative restraint: no banned term remains across any listing-facing field (title / bullet_1..5 / description / search_terms). Metadata fields like resolution_action are exempt.

image_recommendation selects the overlay-free image (product_image_a.jpg), rejects the discount-overlay image (product_image_b.jpg), and the reason cites the promo overlay / 20% / discount / Best Seller / OCR finding.

suppression_reason_resolutions[PROHIBITED_PROMO] has a real evidence_file (field-level export / restricted-claims policy / workbench / current_listing_state) AND a resolution_action that names the promo phrase removal / title rewrite.

suppression_reason_resolutions[UNSUPPORTED_PERFORMANCE] cites supplier_certificates.md (LAB-TEMP-750-APR) or the field-level export AND a resolution_action that narrows to lab evidence / cold-only / removes the 24h hot claim.

suppression_reason_resolutions[RESTRICTED_SAFETY_CLAIM] cites the restricted-claims policy or supplier_certificates.md (CERT-BPA-2025) AND a resolution_action that removes safety language / replaces with BPA evidence.
suppression_reason_resolutions[IMAGE_TEXT_PROMO] cites the OCR result / clean photo / workbench / field-level export AND a resolution_action that swaps to the clean image / removes the overlay.

suppression_reason_resolutions[COMPETITOR_BRAND_TERM] cites the field-level export / candidate copy options / restricted-claims policy / catalog thread AND a resolution_action that removes Stanley/Yeti / replaces backend search.

suppression_reason_resolutions[DISHWASHER_SCOPE_CONFLICT] cites supplier_certificates.md (LAB-DISH-750-MAR) / field-level export / candidate copy options AND a resolution_action that narrows to top-rack LoopCap / hand-wash body.

suppression_reason_resolutions[ENVIRONMENTAL_CLAIM_UNSUPPORTED] cites supplier_certificates.md (PACK-BOM-750-MAY) / catalog thread / field-level export AND a resolution_action that removes eco / zero-waste / carbon and optionally narrows to recycled paperboard.
fields_needing_more_evidence has at least 1 entry that names an explicitly-unverifiable topic from the supplier evidence (hot retention beyond 12h / carbon-neutral / zero-waste / competitor price).

Supporting artifacts are grounded: evidence_manifest.json references >=3 real source-file paths under workspace/{source_evidence,review_inputs,policies,listing,workbench,messages}/, and the recovery note covers >=4 of the 5 required topics (title change, bullet compliance, evidence/lab citation, image swap, search-terms cleanup).
